question: Who among the following was the first Indian table tennis player ever to become a nine times senior national champion as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Achanta Sharath Kamal**__.

__
 
• **Achanta Sharath Kamal was the first Indian table tennis player ever to become nine times senior national champion as of January 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Achanta Sharath Kamal **is a professiona**l table tennis player **from** India.**

 
 
• He is the** first Indian table tennis player** ever to become **nine times Senior National Champion** hence breaking the **record** of eight times** National Champion Kamlesh Mehta**.
 
• In **2019 **he was awarded the **Padma Shri,** I**ndia's fourth-highest civilian award.**
 
• In the year **2007**, he was the** first Indian **to **win** the **Pyongyang Invitational Tournament** held at **Pyongyang, North Korea.**
